environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with a standard S3 gateway endpoint (no endpoint policy restrictions). The service is exposed via an internal ALB with no path-based restrictions. IMDSv1 is enabled on the task. No cache eviction or memory limits configured. The /debug/cache endpoint is accessible to any caller that can reach the ALB.

config.s3_endpoint: com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 gateway endpoint, default full-access policy
config.alb: Internal ALB, no path restrictions, all paths forwarded to target group
config.memory_limit: none (soft limit only, no OOM kill configured)
